blurb: Potowomut Golf Club is a private golf club founded in 1927 with an 18-hole championship course designed by Walter Johnson. The club offers a classic walking course with practice facilities including three grass driving ranges and a short-game complex. It hosts private events such as weddings, corporate outings, and golf tournaments with full course access and catering options.
extraNote: Every event is priced by proposal based on group size, season, and format · Deposit required to secure event date · Popular dates fill well in advance, especially weddings · Potowomut Golf Club clubhouse at 439 Ives Road, Warwick, RI
